about: One ordinary pointer movement: from the page body to the gap right of the 'Run again' button, then a straight 0.6 s min-jerk glide leftwards onto the button (60 Hz, the rate a browser delivers pointermove). Then the worker's own four scattered points inside the button with 700 ms rests. Chosen from attacks-legacy-order.mjs --search (approach #1), predicted wrong before this run.
